examples.arabic: قال لموظف الصرافة بصوت متقطع يفتقر إلى هدوئه المعتاد عذرا هل يمكنني سحب خمسة آلاف جنيه مصري فورا من حسابي؟
examples.english: He said to the teller with a broken voice lacking his usual calmness, excuse me, can I withdraw five thousand Egyptian pounds immediately from my account?
examples.transliteration: qala li-muwazzafi as-sirafati bi-sawtin mutaqatti'in yaftaqiru ila hudu'ihi al-mu'tadi udhran hal yumkinuni sahbu khamsati alafi junayhin misriyyin fawran min hisabi?
examples.storyTitle: A Race Against Time in Downtown

examples.english: So the cat immediately jumped on the bed.
examples.storyTitle: A Funny Visit to Aunt's House

examples.arabic: ابتسم البائع وقال: تفضلي، سأساعدك فوراً.
examples.english: The seller smiled and said: "Please, I will help you immediately."
examples.transliteration: Ibtasama al-ba'i' wa qala: "Tafaddali, sa'usa'iduki fawran."
